title: Owner Burnout: What Should You Hand Off First?

scenes.say: Doing every job yourself? Drop one. On purpose.
Hand off first what someone else can do almost as well. Opening and closing. Ordering stock. And the big one: the schedule.
It won't be done exactly your way. But eighty percent as good, by someone else, beats a hundred percent by an owner who's burnt out.

props.caption: Done by someone else vs *by you, exhausted*

scenes.say: So: write down how you do it, once. Show them twice, then let them do it. And check in after a week, not every hour.
